```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
print(arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::slice_sample(n = 10) |>
  dplyr::collect()
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  dplyr::filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  dplyr::group_by(coin_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  dplyr::collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- arrow::read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- arrow::read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- arrow::read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    dplyr::rename(categories, category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = as.Date(lubridate::parse_date_time(
      launch_date,
      orders = c("B d, Y", "Y-m-d"),
      quiet = TRUE
    ))
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  dplyr::select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  dplyr::filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = as.Date(date_raw), y = price_usd)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Date", y = "Price (USD)", title = "Bitcoin Daily Price")
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  dplyr::group_by(date, category_name) |>
  dplyr::summarise(category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(market_cap_share = category_market_cap / sum(category_market_cap, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    category_name = forcats::fct_reorder(
      category_name,
      category_market_cap,
      .fun = median,
      .desc = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = market_cap_share, fill = category_name)) +
  ggplot2::geom_area() +
  ggplot2::geom_rect(
    data = tibble::tribble(
      ~xmin, ~xmax, ~label,
      as.Date("2022-05-07"), as.Date("2022-05-12"), "Luna/UST crash",
      as.Date("2022-11-08"), as.Date("2022-11-11"), "FTX collapse"
    ),
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.16
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    data = tibble::tribble(
      ~date, ~label,
      as.Date("2022-05-09"), "Luna/UST crash",
      as.Date("2022-11-09"), "FTX collapse"
    ),
    ggplot2::aes(x = date, y = 0.97, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total crypto market cap",
    fill = "Category (median size, largest first)",
    title = "How Crypto Market Capitalization Is Distributed",
    subtitle = "Daily share of total market cap represented by each coin category",
    caption = "Source: Crypto market data provided with this analysis."
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis", direction = 1)
```
